mechanism: A small anomaly leaves a low-information real anchor as one continuously tracked carrier, escalates from flat trace to spatial figure to volumetric material, uses a contact peak to distribute its visual grammar across ordinary environmental anchors, then contracts into a reduced residue that returns to an opening-equivalent location.

invariants.rule: Introduce one legible impossible seed on a stable ordinary anchor before explaining it.
invariants.purpose: Creates an immediate boundary question and gives the later return a remembered destination.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the environment is already magical or the origin is unclear, the crossing event and loop closure lose meaning.

invariants.rule: Keep one identifiable carrier or trajectory visible across every handoff, and motivate camera attention with that carrier.
invariants.purpose: Turns multiple visual effects into one causal journey rather than an unrelated montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: If each location receives a different unconnected effect, the viewer cannot infer propagation or anticipate the next state.

invariants.rule: Escalate through at least three materially different representation regimes before the environmental peak.
invariants.purpose: Resets attention through increasing dimensional commitment and scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the carrier remains only a line or instantly becomes the final world effect, the middle loses discovery and the peak feels unearned.

invariants.rule: Use recurring practical anchors first as ordinary objects and later as hosts for the transformed visual grammar.
invariants.purpose: Provides scale, continuity and proof that the phenomenon has spread into the world.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without repeated anchors, the expanded effect reads as a detached full-screen transition rather than a rewrite of the same setting.

invariants.rule: After the maximum-scale state, reduce the effect to one small residue and return it to the origin or a clear opening analogue.
invariants.purpose: Releases the spectacle, proves control over scale and creates replayable closure.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the film ends at the largest burst, it becomes a conventional escalation demo with no structural return or loop memory.

slots.name: origin_anchor
slots.constraint: A visually simple real surface or object that can host the first anomaly and the final residue.

slots.name: carrier
slots.constraint: One trackable point, filament, droplet, particle or shadow whose path remains causally continuous.

slots.name: representation_ladder
slots.constraint: At least three distinct stages such as trace, spatial figure, volumetric material and environment-wide system.

slots.name: practical_anchor_chain
slots.constraint: Two to four ordinary environmental objects revisited during propagation.

slots.name: contact_trigger
slots.constraint: One physically readable interaction or threshold crossing that causes the largest propagation change.

slots.name: environment_rewrite_medium
slots.constraint: A coherent graphic or material grammar that can spread across the existing setting without replacing its geometry.

slots.name: camera_follow_strategy
slots.constraint: A motivated follow, track, orbit or focus handoff that keeps the carrier legible; exact carrier and shot count may vary.

slots.name: return_residue
slots.constraint: A quieter, smaller state related to the carrier but not a copy of the source feather-like ending.

slots.name: designed_sound_family
slots.constraint: Newly authored material and propagation sounds synchronized to the chosen transformation; not asserted as source audio.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source open sketchbook, two standing figures, warm shop-like clutter, bicycle, exposed bulb, denim pocket, leaves and magazine stacks
the source star-led white trail, angular hovering drawing, cyan-pink-violet spiral, feather-like residue and exact colour sequence
the exact page-to-floor-to-person-to-lamp-to-bicycle-to-page traversal, compositions and beat durations
the creator name, MiniMax H3 marketing claim, After Effects comparison and all source-thread wording

instantiations.concept: In a midnight greenhouse, one dew bead on a fogged glass panel sprouts a bioluminescent filament, travels across leaf veins, expands into a translucent manta-like canopy form, converts the greenhouse into a cyan botanical contour system, then condenses back into one ordinary bead on the original pane.
instantiations.prompt_seed: A dew-born filament crosses greenhouse anchors, escalates in dimensionality, rewrites the same space as botanical contours and returns as one bead.

instantiations.concept: On a dark bakery cooling slab, a sugar crystal releases an amber heat thread. A low lateral track follows it across perforated racks and copper tool handles; when the thread snaps through a falling glaze droplet, a crisp glassy ping triggers its expansion into a transparent spun-sugar weather vane. The camera cranes to a high oblique view as a warm thermal-map glaze spreads across the kitchen, then the sound thins to dry cooling clicks while the carrier crystallizes at the slab's far edge.
instantiations.prompt_seed: A low tracked sugar-heat carrier crosses bakery anchors, uses a falling-glaze contact and glassy sound peak to spread a thermal map, then cools into one distant crystal.

instantiations.concept: Inside a quiet transit hall, a punched dot on a paper ticket becomes a red signal filament, follows rail grooves and clock hands, grows into a translucent route volume, redraws the station as a moving network diagram, then returns as one fresh punch mark on a different corner of the ticket.
instantiations.prompt_seed: A ticket mark becomes a network carrier, scales through the station and contracts into a final punched residue.

failure_modes.failure: The film stacks unrelated glowing effects without a persistent carrier.
failure_modes.repair: Give every state the same trajectory, colour seed or material fingerprint and show each handoff on a recurring anchor.

failure_modes.failure: The environment changes before the carrier earns the scale increase.
failure_modes.repair: Complete trace, spatial figure and volumetric stages before activating the world-scale grammar.

failure_modes.failure: The final return copies the source page-and-feather ending.
failure_modes.repair: Change the origin class, residue material, camera implementation and return path while preserving only scale contraction and structural closure.

failure_modes.failure: Camera motion competes with the small carrier.
failure_modes.repair: Use one motivated move per beat, slow at each handoff and keep at least one stable practical anchor in frame.
